surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the decomposition of PDMAT (pentakis(dimethylamido)tantalum(V)) and the subsequent reaction with ammonia (NH3). The decomposition of PDMAT leads to the formation of Ta[N(CH3)2]4(g) and the release of byproducts such as HN(CH3)2(g). The Ta[N(CH3)2]4(g) reacts with surface sites to form TaN, with the release of additional byproducts.
evidence: The text describes the decomposition of PDMAT into Ta[N(CH3)2]4(g) and the reaction with NH3, leading to the formation of TaN. It also mentions the release of byproducts such as HN(CH3)2(g) and the formation of surface species like Ta(N) during the ALD process.
